stem: Which statement accurately describes the reasons for establishing Plymouth and Jamestown?

options.label: A
options.text: Both colonies were established to bring wealth to stockholders.

options.label: B
options.text: Plymouth’s founders intended to produce raw materials, while Jamestown’s founders expected to discover gold.

options.label: C
options.text: Both colonies were established to limit the expansion of other European empires.

options.label: D
options.text: Plymouth was founded as a refuge from religious persecution, while Jamestown was founded for commercial profit.
